chain.title: Pages Torn From Nowhere
chain.desc: Manuscript pages drop from myrmex and appear in dungeon loot; three of them bind into the Bestiary.

chain.title: The Book That Names Monsters
chain.desc: The Bestiary is crafted from three manuscripts and reveals dragon den and mob knowledge in-world.

chain.title: Pale Metal in Deep Stone
chain.desc: Silver ore and deepslate silver ore smelt into silver ingots, the base metal of the mod's early gear.

chain.title: Talons on the Wind
chain.desc: Hippogryphs nest across plains and mountains and are the first real fight the mod puts in your way.

chain.title: A Curved Trophy
chain.desc: Hippogryph talons drop on death and craft into the hippogryph sword.

chain.title: Rocks That Woke Up
chain.desc: Forest, frost and mountain trolls roam caves at night and hit far harder than anything vanilla at that depth.

chain.title: Torn From the Jaw
chain.desc: Troll tusks drop from all three troll variants and feed the troll weapon recipes.

chain.title: One Eye, One Chance
chain.desc: Cyclopes guard beach caves stocked with stolen sheep and deal enormous melee damage.

chain.title: The Eye That Watched You
chain.desc: The cyclops eye drops on death and is a core ingredient of the dragon summoning crystals.

chain.title: Do Not Look Back
chain.desc: The gorgon lairs in her temple and petrifies anything that meets her gaze; a blindfold is the counter.

chain.title: A Head Still Staring
chain.desc: The severed gorgon head can be wielded to turn other mobs to stone.

chain.title: Coils in the Cold Water
chain.desc: Sea serpents surface in deep oceans in seven colours and are the ocean tier of the mod.

chain.title: Salt-Bitten Ivory
chain.desc: Sea serpent fangs pair with serpent scales for tide armor and the tide trident.

chain.title: Wax in Your Ears
chain.desc: Sirens sing from ocean islands and drown anyone who listens; earplugs or a blindfold break the charm.

chain.title: Regicide in the Hive
chain.desc: Desert and jungle myrmex hives are ruled by a queen whose death collapses the colony.

chain.title: Cut One, Grow Two
chain.desc: The hydra lives in swamp caves and regrows every severed head unless the stumps are burned.

chain.title: Still Beating
chain.desc: The hydra heart is the boss drop that grants regeneration when consumed.

chain.title: Ribs of the Fallen
chain.desc: Dragon bone drops from dragon skeletons and slain dragons and is the backbone of the dragon tech tree.

chain.title: First Blade of Bone
chain.desc: Dragon bone crafts a sword above diamond, the stepping stone to the elemental blades.

chain.title: Down Comes the Red
chain.desc: An adult fire dragon is the mod's centrepiece kill and the only source of fire dragon blood and heart.

chain.title: Blood That Burns Cold
chain.desc: Fire dragon blood is the reagent that turns ordinary iron into dragonsteel.

chain.title: A Forge That Eats Flame
chain.desc: Dragonforge bricks and the fire core build a forge that only a living dragon's breath can light.

chain.title: Iron Reborn in the Forge
chain.desc: The dragonforge cooks iron with fire dragon blood for a thousand ticks into dragonsteel fire ingots.

chain.title: The Last Sword You Need
chain.desc: Two dragonsteel fire ingots on a witherbone haft make the strongest weapon Ice and Fire offers.

notes: Verified against iceandfire 2.1.13-1.20.1-beta-5 (Modrinth slug 'ice-and-fire-dragons'). Item ids = assets/iceandfire/models/item stems intersected with item./block. lang keys, PLUS dragonegg_<colour> and dragonscales_<colour>, which share a single lang key each (item.iceandfire.dragonegg and .dragonscales) and so fail a naive intersection; both families were confirmed directly against IafItemRegistry. Note the block is dragonscale_<colour> (singular) while the item is dragonscales_<colour> (plural) - the scale wheel uses the item form. Entity ids come from IafEntityRegistry, not from lang: the lang file also carries variant subkeys (hippogryph.alex, pixie.type_0) and two names with no registry entry at all, dread_queen and black_frost_dragon, which were dropped. The ice and lightning branches mirror the fire branch exactly (dragonforge_<element>_core plus <element>_dragon_blood into dragonsteel_<element>_ingot, tag forge:bones/wither for the haft) and are folded into the dragonsteel wheel rather than repeated as chain steps. moddb agreement: manuscript (6 packs) and bestiary (8 packs) sit earliest, matching this chain; blindfold (6 packs, pos 0.215) is placed mid-run by moddb but is really the gorgon counter, so it is named in the gorgon step instead of getting its own. moddb entry iceandfire:dragon_seeker does not exist in this jar and was ignored.
